card.product_version_note: Refreshed July 25, 2024: annual fee rose from $250 to $325; Resy Credit ($100/yr) and Dunkin' Credit ($84/yr) added; Five Guys added to the Dining Credit. Per the issuer's July 25, 2024 press release (read via Business Wire; the americanexpress.com newsroom URL redirected to the newsroom index): 'For existing Card Members, the new annual fee will take effect on the Card Members' annual renewal date starting October 1, 2024, on a rolling basis.' A second refresh around late April / early May 2026 (card's 60th anniversary) added 5X on prepaid hotels via Amex Travel, complimentary Hertz Five Star status, and Buffalo Wild Wings and Wonder as Dining Credit partners, with Goldbelly and wine.com removed as of July 1, 2026; the annual fee stayed at $325. The 2026 refresh details come from Frequent Miler (2026-05-04) and Doctor of Credit, not an issuer page; the current issuer product page reflects the post-refresh terms (5X hotels, Hertz, Buffalo Wild Wings, Wonder; Goldbelly and wine.com no longer listed). The issuer product page read today says nothing about which cardholder cohorts are on which terms.

benefits.name: $120 Dining Credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $10 in statement credits per calendar month (up to $120 per year). Issuer Credit Intel page: 'Statement credits and Uber Cash do not roll over'; 'All unused credits or Uber Cash expire at the end of each month'; credits 'reset on the first day of each calendar month'. Credits 'typically post in a few days but may take up to eight weeks'.
benefits.enrollment_note: Product page: 'Enrollment required.' Enroll via Account > Rewards & Benefits > Benefits, the Amex App, or by phone.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Pay with the Gold Card at Grubhub (including Seamless), Buffalo Wild Wings, Five Guys, The Cheesecake Factory, or Wonder (issuer product page, read today). Merchant history (secondary sources, Frequent Miler and Doctor of Credit): Buffalo Wild Wings and Wonder added in the spring 2026 refresh; Goldbelly and wine.com removed as of July 1, 2026; Five Guys added July 25, 2024 (issuer press release).
benefits.verification_note: Amount, merchants, and enrollment read on the issuer product page today; rollover and posting language read on the issuer Credit Intel page (americanexpress.com) today.

benefits.name: $120 Uber Cash
benefits.period_note: $10 in Uber Cash each month (up to $120 per year). Delivered as Uber Cash in the Uber account, not as a statement credit. Issuer Credit Intel page: unused Uber Cash expires at the end of each month and does not roll over; resets on the first day of each calendar month.
benefits.enrollment_note: Product page says 'when you add your Gold Card to your Uber account'; the Credit Intel page frames adding the Card to the Uber account as the enrollment step. No separate benefit enrollment is stated.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Uber Eats orders and Uber rides in the U.S. when an Amex Card is selected as the payment method.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page and the issuer Credit Intel page today.

benefits.name: $100 Resy Credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $50 in statement credits January through June and up to $50 July through December, for up to $100 per calendar year. The issuer pages read today do not state rollover language specific to the Resy Credit; the Credit Intel page's no-rollover language is written for the monthly credits.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible purchases paid with the Gold Card at over 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants. Press release (2024) adds Resy.com and the Resy mobile app. Credit Intel page: a Resy account is not required.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today. Effective date is from the issuer's July 25, 2024 press release (Business Wire).

benefits.name: $84 Dunkin' Credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $7 in statement credits per month (up to $84 per year). Issuer Credit Intel page: unused credits expire at the end of each month and do not roll over.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Pay with the Gold Card at U.S. Dunkin' locations.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today. Effective date is from the issuer's July 25, 2024 press release (Business Wire).

benefits.name: The Hotel Collection $100 credit
benefits.period_note: Per booking: 'Benefits are applied per room, per stay (with a three-room limit per stay).' Applied at check-out by the property, not as an Amex statement credit. Must be used during the stay; not redeemable for cash.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Book two consecutive nights or more at a Hotel Collection property (over 1,300 hotels per product page) through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App, paid with the eligible Card. Eligible on-property charges vary by property. Also includes room upgrade and 12pm check-in / 4pm late check-out when available. Back-to-back stays within 24 hours at the same property count as one stay.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page and the issuer Hotel Collection page today.

benefits.name: American Express Venue Collection: 10% back on concessions
benefits.period_note: 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases, up to $250 back per calendar year. amount_cents is the annual cap.
benefits.enrollment_note: Product page: enroll your Card; 'Limit one enrolled Card per Card Member.'
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Qualifying concessions purchases at American Express Venue Collection venues with the enrolled Card. The product page does not list specific venues.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Complimentary Hertz Five Star Status
benefits.period_note: Complimentary status upgrade; the product page states no expiry or re-enrollment period.
benefits.enrollment_note: Product page lists enrollment as required.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star tier. Added in the spring 2026 refresh per Frequent Miler and Doctor of Credit (secondary).
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.period_note: Up to $300 per trip; maximum 2 claims per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Round-trip paid for entirely with the Eligible Card; a covered reason delays the trip more than 12 hours. Underwritten by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.period_note: Up to $1,250 for carry-on baggage and up to $500 for checked baggage, in excess of common carrier coverage. New York State residents: $10,000 aggregate maximum for all Covered Persons per Covered Trip. amount_cents is the carry-on cap.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Entire fare for the Common Carrier trip purchased with the Eligible Card.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.period_note: Per rental. The product page states no dollar cap.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Reserve and pay for the Entire Rental with the Eligible Card and decline the collision damage waiver (CDW). Secondary coverage; no liability coverage. Not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.period_note: Up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year. amount_cents is the per-purchase cap.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Covers accidental damage, theft, or loss for up to 90 days from the Covered Purchase date.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.period_note: Up to $10,000 per item, up to $50,000 per Card Member account per calendar year. amount_cents is the per-item cap.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Adds up to one extra year to the Original Manufacturer's Warranty for warranties of 5 years or less. Coverage is up to the actual amount charged to the Eligible Card for the item.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Purchases made abroad carry no foreign transaction fee.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Additional Cards: first 5 at $0 annual fee
benefits.period_note: First 5 Additional Cards carry a $0 annual fee; the sixth and each later Additional Card costs $35 per year.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Additional Card Members must be 13 or older; purchases by Additional Card Members earn points on the account.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: 24/7 emergency assistance when traveling more than 100 miles from home. Third-party service costs may be the Card Member's responsibility.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.

benefits.name: Amex Presale and Reserved Tickets
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Access to presale and reserved tickets for select events when purchased with the Card.
benefits.verification_note: Read on the issuer product page today.
